notes: A cleaner look in the app icon's blue and gold, with a Light theme under Settings > Look. Settings is one page that scrolls. New: View > Legend shows each page's colours on screen, and File > Export Quantities PDF… saves a quantities sheet. Toolbar labels shrink to icons on a narrow window, and tips show in the bottom bar. Menu labels use Capital Words and QtyF shows as ×. Claude's tools are fewer and simpler (old names still work). A click on empty drawing now turns For Claude off too.
